# Prime quadruplets generated by $p = 3\phi(k) + \phi(n-k) - 1$

> Let $\phi$ denote Euler's totient function. The sequence $a(n)$ counts the number of integers
> $0 < k < n$ such that $p = 3\phi(k) + \phi(n-k) - 1$, $p + 2$, $p + 6$, and $p + 8$ are all prime.
>
> *References:*
> - [A236511](https://oeis.org/A236511)
